title: E2E: Migration flow preserves anonymous progress
description: Playwright e2e test verifying that anonymous user progress is correctly migrated to authenticated account when 'Bring my progress' is checked.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test setup: Start with clean browser, no auth
Test: As anonymous user, practice a song and mark 3+ words learned
Test: Verify localStorage has songscript_visitor_id with data
Test: Navigate to /signup, check 'Bring my progress' is ON
Test: After login, dashboard shows the migrated word count
Test: Verify localStorage songscript_visitor_id is CLEARED
Test: Verify user can still see their learned words on song page
All tests pass: bun run test:e2e --grep 'migration-flow'
